# Interlibrary loan requests

An interlibrary loan is requested when no copy of a title exists anywhere in the
system and the title is not on order. Requests are taken at a service desk or
through the catalogue, and are capped at 5 open requests per card.

The supplying library sets the loan period and whether renewal is permitted; the
borrowing branch cannot extend a loan it did not grant. Most supplying libraries
grant 28 days with no renewal.

A request costs 2.50, charged when the item arrives rather than when the request
is placed, and is not refunded if the borrower declines the item on arrival.

Items received on interlibrary loan may not be placed on hold by a second
borrower, may not be taken outside the building where the supplier has marked
them library-use-only, and must be returned to the desk they were collected
from rather than a book drop, because they are checked back to the supplier by
hand.
